evidence: Conditional planning quantities, capacity requirements and future-price allowances. No selected sites, qualified roof, surveyed extraction allocation, supplier quotation or completion-date forecast.
numeraire: U: the world-economy transferable common-price real unit; no conversion to present dollars.

quantity.status: All added coefficients are study assumptions. Ordinary stock is held at the existing 100t/person reference in every price case. Bulk and metal yields include rejects; retained tails get no reuse credit. The independent-support and foundation quantities are allowances, not a solved load path. Effective handling is a complete short-haul excavation/transport/placement system, assumed at 50 t/hour for 4,000 available hours/year; an individual digger rate alone cannot meet it. Haul distance awaits actual sites. Regional vehicle/docking mass and radiator pumps/controls are separate import allowances; power hardware includes receivers, converters and distribution.

services.garden_area: All nonlake ground outside building footprints; roof and balcony planting need an additional lighting design.
services.commissioning_and_ordinary_capital_rule: Ordinary buildings, food plants, routine services and their normal capital are included in the economic allowance. Power, storage, exterior vacuum radiators, public-garden lighting and the townwide enclosure are additions. Food uses the existing fully lamp-lit process bracket, with an explicit 10kW/person reference, not the incomplete power-made-food route.

price_rules: All new U prices and fixed allowances are scenarios, not converted contemporary dollar quotations. Ordinary capital uses the existing economic allowance without adding its stock-times-price proxy.

Installed unit charges include fabrication, delivery/placement, supplier equipment, operation and capital recovery within their boundary. Supplier factories, freight fleets and generation capital are not added a second time.

The industrial-establishment increment covers extra regional mobilization, construction camps, commissioning and start-up losses above normal supplier capital recovery already included in installed charges. It is an unengineered allowance, not a second complete factory bill.
The qualification allowance is the incremental full-scale pressure/protection/repair/transition development programme beyond ordinary R&D. No revenue or residual asset sale offsets it.

The entire new regional infrastructure requirement and establishment increment are assigned to the first 100; future towns receive no advance allocation credit. Upstream industries must be orderable and charge attributable service/capacity; their civilization-wide creation is outside this estimate.

The ordinary-import freight increment is only the extra vacuum delivery burden above normal logistics in ordinary installed capital. Pressure, power and volatile imports are already delivered in their own rows.

Contingency applies once to direct construction. The separate removal reserve is 5% of direct construction, an initial funding allowance rather than a present engineering estimate or future recovery performance.

Cost excludes financing, migration fares, resident consumption and long-vacuum operation/renewal. Protective qualification and site clearance are conditions; allowances do not establish their success.

On-site material and road supplier prices exclude project-provided electricity and exterior cooling. Dedicated generation/beam hardware and radiators are capitalized here once; construction electricity adds only variable utility operating cost, with no second generation capital charge. Off-site manufacture and delivery remain inside their installed unit prices.

schedule.rule: All lead tasks start together. Production begins after their maximum, and reaches 25/50/75/100% in successive production years. Each stream accumulates complete-town kits; a site starts only with every kit and a free team. Occupation follows a whole site cycle including environmental commissioning and garden establishment. This conservative kit model permits upstream stockpiling and separates steady throughput from site concurrency; it is not a site-level construction programme. Each production stream stops at this programme's quantity; unused capacity creates no unpriced inventory. Construction-plant and full dedicated-power hardware arrive during the lead, charged once and removed from later town kits. Their minimum delivery time uses25% of the special-import capacity; it is an additional parallel prerequisite.

reserve_diagnostic.rule: Prospective raw-feed reservation for processed local bulk and metals over the horizon, after a complete collection/treatment/usable-return fraction. Loose shielding stays in recoverable stock and is excluded from replacement throughput. No existing reserve or achieved recovery rate is asserted; element-specific grades, losses and future requirements still govern extraction.
